summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine share repurchases under its buyback program announced July 21, 2026. During August 31–September 4, 2026, it repurchased 674,826 Class A ordinary shares on Nasdaq and/or US venues and 507,952 on the London Stock Exchange and CHIX, all through Goldman Sachs International. The company expects to repurchase up to £405 million (~$540 million) under the program. Repurchased shares will be held in treasury. The filing is a routine transaction-in-own-shares disclosure made under UK Listing Rule 14.3.17(2), evidencing ongoing capital returns rather than a one-off special situation.
